Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: CLASSIFICATION

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Matching, part of CLASSIFICATION in PP2 MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Which objects look and pairing learner should be able to: objects from the environment alike?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian
